explanation: The comment test reads a source's comment table without checking it exists (line 429). A source with no comment file has no table (lines 330-332, 341-343), so choosing the comment filter while viewing such a section fails with an unhandled error instead of treating the policy as having no comment, as the 'blank when no table' rule (businessrule-17359667392864425569) implies. State this outcome, or record an assumption if you read it as unsettled. Also say each test applies only when its filter option is set.

The editor section is Math.Min of the viewed section and the found section, with Computer=1, User=2, Both=3. That is not 'the narrower of the two': viewing Computer only and finding a User policy opens the Computer section, one the found policy was not named for; only viewing both gives the found section. Write the outcome per combination in the business's words. Also the policy is focused afterwards only if its category is shown (businessrule-06898586959017753270).

The rule omits that answering No to loading the default folder shows no message at all and leaves the workspace empty (loadFailReason stays blank, line 81). It also omits that the default folder is saved as the source before it is loaded (line 71), so it stays saved even if loading it fails, and that load errors in the default folder are only reported, with no continue question (line 73).

The selected policy is dropped whenever the view had to move up to an ancestor (line 223), not only when unlisted; it is kept only when the current category stays listed and the policy still passes. If no ancestor is listed the current category becomes none. Say both.

says: Closing or clearing the definitions workspace also discards the earlier search results (ClearAdmxWorkspace calls FindResults.ClearSearch), so Find Next and Search Results start empty after a workspace is closed, replaced by a download or reloaded for a language change. Write this as a rule on that block; also that Find by Text or Registry starts a search only when its dialog was accepted (lines 645-671).
